notes:
Summary: Marigold is a nationwide outpatient provider network with a heavy corpus of clinical notes (progress notes, discharge summaries, imaging reports). Looking for RAG-first search: embeddings + reranking to drive clinician search results. Key asks: 1) cost per query at scale (target <= $0.002/token-equivalent for combined embed+rerank), 2) avg 95th %-ile query latency under 300ms for single-shot clinician queries, 3) strict PHI controls (no cross-tenant leakage), 4) private networking + SAML SSO + full immutable audit logs.

POC scope proposed: index ~10M documents (est. 600M tokens) in pre-prod, evaluate two embedding models and a learned cross-encoder reranker. Measure end-to-end p99 latency with dedicated GPU pool + cache enabled. Validate rollback/fallback to smaller quantized models for cost testing.

Quotes: "We cannot accept any PHI leaving our VPC — must be private-control plane or on-prem." — Head of Infra. "If reranker improves precision at recall 0.8 by 6-8%, we can justify the extra cost." — Dir of Clinical Informatics.
